name: menu-reader
description: Voice-first menu reader for low-vision diners

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client:phone"
scripts.client:phone: cd client && npm run dev -- --mode phone
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
